text:
fiona: starting targeted smoke for q6b-int4. local runs show a small hit on 'long-abstractive' and some stepwise instruction tasks. want a 750-sample focused pull + fresh golden. who can run sampling?
rahul: I can handle curation. what split do we want?
fiona: plan: 65% long-abstractive, 20% stepwise-instr, 15% code-doc-loss. micro-golden: 160 full-golden, rest fast-review.
li: quick ask 1: do we dedupe first? last time paraphrase dupes affected the golden. propose fuzzyhash=0.89 + cluster-prune to keep anchors unique.
label-bot: queued sample job id lb-294567 SELECT id, prompt, meta FROM samplebank WHERE slice IN ('long-abstractive','stepwise-instr','code_doc_loss') ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 750; ETA ~7m. :robot_face:
ops-bot: labeler backlog ~210. Reserving 160 golden keeps SLA ~55m; if golden >200 SLA can exceed 2h.
rahul: pipeline update: [filter_slice, exact_fingerprint_dedupe, fuzzy_dedupe(thresh=0.89), cluster_prune(min_size=2), stratified_sample] then route 160->golden.
fiona: also attach baselines q8b-int3 and q6b-fp16. want token-diff, rougeL_delta, and a compact comparator CSV with columns: id, rougeL_delta, token_ins, token_del, primary_flag.
devx-cog: will attach comparator script and upload artifacts. quick pseudocode: ```python
for row in sample:
  out_q6 = fetch_out('q6b-int4', row.id)
  out_q8 = fetch_out('q8b-int3', row.id)
  compute(rougeL, token_diff)
  write_row()
``` artifacts s3://redwood-curation/294567/lb-294567/comparator.csv when done.
li: labeling instruction: prioritize completeness of steps and avoid hallucinated steps. include 3 short exemplars per slice in the task.
zara: also log if the model drops docstrings or truncates code blocks; that's a frequent regression pattern.
label-bot: sample job complete. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/294567/lb-294567/ (sampled.csv, dedupe_log.txt). 160 -> golden, 590 -> expedited-review. :white_check_mark:
devx-cog: comparator finished: s3://redwood-curation/294567/lb-294567/comparator.csv (summary: long-abstractive avg rougeL_delta = -0.036, stepwise-instr avg = -0.057; top ids: 204, 811, 499).
fiona: stepwise-instr crossing our soft threshold (-0.05). will do quick triage on top-20 regressions before any rollout decision. can ops bundle any function-call traces where metadata contains function_call:true?
ops-bot: yes. collecting function_call logs and will upload to s3://redwood-curation/294567/lb-294567/function_logs.tar.gz. ETA ~12m.
rahul: starting golden review of 160; will prioritize stepwise-instr and tag structural failures. if >12% structural failure in golden we mark as regression.
li: extra note: keep a small micro-golden holdout of 40 examples reserved for cross-checks later (not used in initial pass).
zara: good call. tagging those 40 as holdout_microgolden.
fiona: great work. reconvene in 40m to decide go/no-go. if regressions persist after kernel tweaks, plan is to revert to q6b-fp16 for production until fix. :thumbsup:
